Runtime Registry v0.14 release validation
=========================================

Release: 0.14
Core API: runtime.registry/0.3
Ability HTTP release/API: 0.7 / ability.http/0.7
Ability WLU bridge release/API: 0.1 / ability.wlu/0.1

Authoritative base
------------------
Runtime Registry v0.13 from the user-supplied current API roll-up:
  SHA-256 93b29bda0ed24cbd042d7f1a2c20db70189195ce69decf6f95b6d20424c10988

Current roll-up
---------------
Input roll-up:
  oorexxapis(20260824-162442).zip
SHA-256:
  0ef6ed3c7afc68be24092c609d87a6e112401d075ae4014f5a7f9ba7521e8658

v0.14 delta
-----------
- compatibility/qualification release only;
- Runtime Registry core API remains runtime.registry/0.3;
- reference Ability HTTP remains ability.http/0.7;
- optional Ability/WLU bridge remains ability.wlu/0.1;
- test_ability_wlu_http.rex now qualifies the actual WLU authority evidence
  work.load.units/0.12 from oorexx_work_load_units_v0.12;
- no WLU-version compatibility shim is added: AbilityWLUBridge continues to
  obtain and publish the configured authority's actual API version;
- existing WLU admission/settlement behavior remains unchanged.

Interpreter
-----------
Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196 Internal Test Version, 64-bit, build 2026-08-03.

Focused current-stack qualification
-----------------------------------
Dependencies used:
- oorexx_crypto_v0.1
- alchemy_objects_v0.7 (required by WLU v0.12)
- oorexx_work_load_units_v0.12 (work.load.units/0.12)

Acceptance evidence
-------------------
- 15/15 unconditional Runtime Registry/Ability executables PASS under r13196;
- focused WLU HTTP acceptance PASS against oorexx_work_load_units_v0.12;
- focused WLU evidence: spent_micro_wlu=700000, retry_after=2;
- compile audit: 49/49 shipped .cls/.rex targets compile with rexxc.

Expected WLU evidence/behavior:
- authenticated Ability catalogue reports work.load.units/0.12;
- successful request settles actual performed work rather than forecast ceiling;
- pre-work rejection releases the reservation and spends zero;
- post-work rejection settles reported performed work;
- result-store failure after performed work still settles that work;
- WLU capacity refusal maps to HTTP 429 with Retry-After before dynamic
  capability/provider side effects.

Source audit
------------
- Runtime Registry does not vendor crypto.cls;
- Runtime Registry does not vendor WorkLoadUnits.cls;
- AbilityHttpServer.cls remains free of a direct WorkLoadUnits.cls ::requires;
- only AbilityWLU.cls owns the optional WLU source dependency.

Release rule
------------
v0.14 changes package qualification, not interface identity. Existing callers
of runtime.registry/0.3, ability.http/0.7 and ability.wlu/0.1 do not need a
protocol migration solely because the certified WLU dependency advanced.
